name: ROG Cetra Control
author: PavelLizunov
description: USB controls and Bluetooth battery/ANC status for ROG Cetra True Wireless SpeedNova; optional USB microphone level.

barWidget.description: USB controls and Bluetooth battery/ANC status for ROG Cetra True Wireless SpeedNova.

schema.label: Interface language code
schema.description: Use system, en, ru, de, fr, es, it, pt, zh, ja, or ko. Unsupported languages fall back to English. This does not change headset voice prompts.

schema.label: Show microphone signal level
schema.description: Opt-in audio peak capture while another app uses Cetra. No recording is saved; silence is not native mute readback. Requires the libpulse helper built by setup.

schema.label: Show battery percent in the bar
Hide when USB and selected Bluetooth audio are disconnected
schema.description: Legacy visibility preference; hideWhenDisconnected overrides it when explicitly saved.

schema.label: Update lighting when the theme changes
schema.description: Opt-in; requires explicit colored lighting apply in each helper session. Off and Cycle are preserved.

schema.label: Hide when USB and selected Bluetooth audio are disconnected
schema.description: Optional override. If unset, use hideWhenReceiverMissing.

schema.label: Selected Bluetooth audio address
schema.description: Set by the panel device picker. Observation only; does not pair or connect.
